bio.id: Memimpin kurikulum teknik akademi dan menangani tim kompetitif. Berpengalaman menangani kelompok usia muda di kompetisi tingkat provinsi.
bio.en: Leads the academy's technical curriculum and handles the competitive squads. Experienced with youth age groups at provincial level competition.

bio.id: Menangani kelompok U-11 dan U-13. Fokus pada pengembangan teknik individu dan pemahaman permainan.
bio.en: Handles the U-11 and U-13 groups. Focused on individual technique and game understanding.

bio.id: Spesialis usia dini. Merancang sesi berbasis permainan agar anak belajar sambil menikmati prosesnya.
bio.en: Early-age specialist. Designs game-based sessions so children learn while enjoying the process.

bio.id: Menangani sesi kiper seluruh kelompok usia, dari handling dasar sampai distribusi bola.
bio.en: Runs goalkeeping sessions across all age groups, from basic handling to distribution.

bio.id: Menyusun program fisik sesuai usia dan menangani protokol pemanasan serta pencegahan cedera.
bio.en: Builds age-appropriate physical programmes and manages warm-up and injury-prevention protocols.

bio.id: Menyiapkan laporan pertandingan dan video review untuk tim kompetitif dan evaluasi individu pemain.
bio.en: Prepares match reports and video reviews for the competitive squads and individual player evaluations.
